title: Multiclass classification: choose one of several classes

steps.label: Three classes
steps.pseudocode: Three possible classes for each email.

steps.label: One email to classify
steps.pseudocode: The new email has two features.

steps.label: One score per class
steps.pseudocode: The model gives one raw score per class.

steps.label: Scores become probabilities
steps.pseudocode: Softmax turns scores into probabilities that sum to 1.
steps.python:
import math

raw = {'personal': 0.5, 'promotional': 1.2, 'spam': 2.1}

def softmax(values):
    exps = [math.exp(v) for v in values]
    return [e / sum(exps) for e in exps]

probs = softmax(list(raw.values()))
print([round(p, 3) for p in probs], round(sum(probs), 3))
# prints: [0.126, 0.253, 0.622] 1.0

steps.label: Choose the largest
steps.pseudocode: Predict the class with the largest probability.
steps.python:
import math

raw = {'personal': 0.5, 'promotional': 1.2, 'spam': 2.1}

def softmax(values):
    exps = [math.exp(v) for v in values]
    return [e / sum(exps) for e in exps]

probs = dict(zip(raw, softmax(list(raw.values()))))
print(max(probs, key=probs.get))
# prints: spam

steps.pseudocode: Each class wins in its own region of feature space.
